text:
[LERR.1.4.11] **Only the fault an expression yields reaches a surface.** A
fault an operand raised is not the expression's fault when a deciding operand
absorbed it, or when [LNUL.4.2]'s order selected another — under `and` / `or`, or
under any other operator ([LNUL.4.10]). Such a fault is not recorded ([RFCS.21.1]),
not asserted as a fault fact ([LERR.9.9]), not delivered to a callback, and not
counted by any metric. [LNUL.4.2] and [LNUL.4.10] leave the evaluation order free,
and reporting a fault the expression did not yield would make what an engine
reports depend on that order.

alloy.name: iret_9_5__v5_order_independent
alloy.note: ORDER INDEPENDENCE: every order gives one answer and records one atom, over every `where` of up to three conjuncts. A positional pick breaks it (TEETH). V5 as stated by [LNUL.4.2] and [IRET.9.5]: a false decides wherever it stands; otherwise the faults resolve by kind, then by the fields of the record (T2I); the evaluation order is free.

alloy.name: rfcs_21_1__rec
alloy.note: M1: the atom recorded -- a fault a filter raised, else the best fault when nothing false stopped it. [LERR.1.4.11]: only the fault the expression yields reaches a surface -- recorded ([RFCS.21.1]), delivered to a callback or counted -- and the model's record stands for all three. Recording every evaluated fault (M2) is not order independent (`gap__m2_order_dependent`, a counterexample tied to no clause).

alloy.name: rfcs_21_1__v5_one_atom
alloy.note: ONE ATOM: kind then body is total over what is recorded, so at most one atom is recorded. Kind alone breaks it (TEETH). [LERR.1.4.11]: only the fault the expression yields reaches a surface -- recorded ([RFCS.21.1]), delivered to a callback or counted -- and the model's record stands for all three. Recording every evaluated fault (M2) is not order independent (`gap__m2_order_dependent`, a counterexample tied to no clause).
